top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a mature, independently reproduced achievement to a clearly separable pair: Katori for the magic-wavelength lattice that cancels the light shift and Ye for bringing strontium lattice clocks to the 1e-18 level. The citation is scoped to lattice trapping at the magic wavelength and the resulting accuracy and stability, so it stays distinct from earlier frequency-comb and ion-control prizes. All eight members already support it, and I judge it on its merits, not only on that support; no award is clearly worse than a well-defined, high-impact award.
